---
title: "Exercise · Your first Rule"
description: "Write and validate one Rule for a Pico."
---

Reusable exercise exemplar. Demonstrates the exercise convention
documented in [`exercises/index.qmd`](../index.qmd).

## Task

Write a single Rule for a Pico of your choice. The Rule must:

- Have a stable `id` in the form `rule.<slug>`.
- Declare a `kind` you would recognize in a real system.
- Include a `value` (or equivalent payload) the Composer could act on.

Save it as `rules/<your-slug>.yaml`.

## Success criteria

- [ ] The file parses as valid YAML.
- [ ] `id`, `kind`, and a payload field are all present.
- [ ] You can explain, in one sentence, what the Composer would do with
      this Rule.

## Hints

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show hint"}
Start from the Hello Pico example in
[`labs/hello-pico/solution.qmd`](../../labs/hello-pico/solution.qmd)
and change the `kind` and `value` to something meaningful in your
own domain.
:::
